fr_html: M. LODER trouve que les amendements de M. Ricci-Busatti vont à l'encontre de tout ce qui a été dit au sein du Comité. Il observe que la Cour serait constituée de quarante cinq juges, choisis par leurs gouvernements.
en_html: M. LODER thought that M. Ricci-Busatti's amendments were directly opposed to all that had been said during the discussions of the Committee. He noticed that the Court was to consist of forty-five judges chosen by their Governments.
